source.fingerprintScope: Sorted path/SHA-256 list of changed and untracked src/tests files, hashed as compact JSON. This is not a commit or complete-repository hash.

implementation.starterVisibility: Only the expressly owner-approved product preset is intentionally public app data. Its values are not copied into this receipt or tracking.
implementation.initialization: Fresh non-sample state and once-only absent legacy profiles; explicit empty/custom plans are authoritative.
implementation.persistence: Existing optional omscsPlan and atomic setting/omscsPlan journal cell; separate device-only initialization-version preference.
implementation.completion: Shared green rows indicate recorded completion, not a passing grade, specialization eligibility or learning mastery.
implementation.gradeRules: A/B for specialization; C can use degree/free-elective space; no double counting or unknown-grade qualification.
implementation.comparison: Six online requirement comparisons with reserved sub-area slots; detailed subject/calendar drafts remain AI-specific.

sources.scope: Bold linked online choices on all six official specialization pages, mapped to the reviewed regular-course catalogue.

qualification.strictTypesAndProductionBuild: passed in the final compact-page browser gate

fullDomain.scope: Full domain run before the subsequent practice-factory correction.

affectedProductionBrowser.scope: Academic guides/records, path drafts, prerequisites, backups, journal, stale tabs, storage failures and tutorial controls.

finalCompactPageBrowser.scope: Final six-section layout, shared edits, default/migration/marker failures, import/reload/export, reviewed replacement/CAS/limits and keyboard section jump.

initialFailuresRetainedLocally: Test typing and Node JSON-import startup blockers.
Actual tutorial save-gate regression from pre-creating its academic proposal; fixed in both practice factories.

limits: No official transcript, GPA, individual degree audit, future enrollment permission or seat verification.
Authored AI recommendations are not an exhaustive grade-allocation solver; conflicts remain explicit.
Human visual/course acceptance and source publication remain separate.
No physical-device or Safari qualification is claimed.
